Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 11
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner misattributed the retrieved birthdates to the wrong directors and inverted the conclusion. Despite correctly finding that Orestis Laskos was born on November 11, 1907 and Sam Irvin on June 14, 1956, the Planner concluded that Allos gia to ekatommyrio’s director was born later and even swapped the dates in the final answer. The correct later-born director is Sam Irvin (Elvira’s Haunted Hills).
